newsitem.title: UK: UK's Capital Corp welcomes DTI decision.
newsitem.headline: UK's Capital Corp welcomes DTI decision.

text.p: British casino operator Capital Corporation Plc welcomed the UK government's decision on Tuesday to block a hostile bid by London Clubs International Plc .

"The board of Capital Corporation welcomes the renewed opportunity to concentrate wholly on developing the business for the benefit of shareholders and clientele at the upper end of the market, where Capital Corporation is pre-eminent," it said in a statement.
Moves to stave off the unsolicited bid have cost Capital Corporation some 3.7 million stg and taken up a lot management time, a company spokesman said.
But Capital was upbeat about its prospects.
"The last six months have seen a number of positive developments in Capital Corporation's businesses including a strengthened board and a significant improvement in operations," the company said.

Margaret Beckett, Secretary of State for Trade and Industry, ruled the proposed 190 million stg deal would be against the public interest. She said a merged company would control 80 percent of business in London's up-market casinos.

London Clubs owns and operates seven London casinos while Capital has two venues in the capital. London Clubs has a 48 percent share of the "drop" -- money exchanged for chips while Capital has 31 percent.
Capital Corp shares fell 18.5p to 165p after the ruling while London Clubs shed 16.5p to 386p.
